state_machine.description: Fresh instance before first scan invocation; outputs and debounce state initialized.
Pump run command is OFF; no valid debounce qualification or safety permissive is false.

transitions.condition: permit = FALSE; keep VFD_RUN FALSE and reset DebounceTimer

state_machine.description: Permissive is TRUE but VISCOSITY_OK has not yet remained continuously valid for DebounceTime.

transitions.condition: permit = FALSE; immediately reset DebounceTimer, clear qualified, force VFD_RUN FALSE
permit = TRUE and DebounceTimer.Q = TRUE; output stage uses current DebounceTimer.Q

state_machine.description: Viscosity debounce is qualified and safety permissive is TRUE; VFD_RUN may be TRUE.

transitions.condition: permit = FALSE; immediately reset DebounceTimer, clear qualified, force VFD_RUN FALSE

state_machine.description: Orthogonal informational indication only; never affects VFD_RUN or the safety permissive.

timers.name: DebounceTimer
timers.call_rule: Unconditional top-level TON FB call exactly once per scan outside CASE/IF, after safety/reset/state-transition logic and before unified output assignments.
timers.timing_semantics: Elapsed time is zero on the first eligible TRUE invocation; Q becomes TRUE only when continuous IN TRUE duration is >= DebounceTime.
constraints: No unobserved past input stability is assumed.

accumulators.name: PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC
accumulators.update: IF final VFD_RUN = TRUE THEN PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC := PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC + TIME_TO_LTIME(CycleTime); ELSE preserve previous value.
constraints: Use 64-bit LTIME for the 500-hour accumulator, not TIME.
Accumulation uses the end-of-scan VFD_RUN value.

thresholds.name: PUMP_MAINT_DUE
reset_conditions: No operational reset input; initialized FALSE at power-up and is a level comparison on accumulated runtime.
thresholds.effect: Informational only; does not modify VFD_RUN, permit, or safety logic.

priorities: Emergency stop has highest priority: PASTE_E_STOP_NC = FALSE immediately forces VFD_RUN = FALSE, resets DebounceTimer, and clears qualified.
Raw viscosity loss has immediate stop priority: VISCOSITY_OK = FALSE immediately forces VFD_RUN = FALSE, resets DebounceTimer, and clears qualified.
Debounce qualification requires VISCOSITY_OK and PASTE_E_STOP_NC to remain TRUE continuously for DebounceTime.
VFD_RUN may be TRUE only when permit = (VISCOSITY_OK AND PASTE_E_STOP_NC) is TRUE and qualified = TRUE.
PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC accumulates CycleTime only when final VFD_RUN is TRUE; stopping preserves the accumulated value.
PUMP_MAINT_DUE is set by PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC >= LTIME#500h and is informational only; it must never override or alter the safety permissive or pump run command.
Power-up initialization must set VFD_RUN = FALSE, PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC = LTIME#0ns, PUMP_MAINT_DUE = FALSE, and reset debounce state.

scan_execution_order.name: edge_sampling
actions: Sample VISCOSITY_OK, PASTE_E_STOP_NC, DebounceTime, and CycleTime exactly once for this scan.
Compute edge flags for VISCOSITY_OK and PASTE_E_STOP_NC.
Capture any immediate reset demand from PASTE_E_STOP_NC = FALSE or VISCOSITY_OK = FALSE.

scan_execution_order.name: safety_reset_priority_and_state_transitions
actions: Apply safety priority first: if PASTE_E_STOP_NC = FALSE or VISCOSITY_OK = FALSE, set qualified = FALSE and request DebounceTimer reset.
Evaluate the run-state machine using permit and prior timer state; STOPPED, DEBOUNCING, RUNNING transitions are handled here.
Ensure maintenance indication never participates in run-state transitions or safety permissive decisions.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional_top_level_timer_fb_calls
actions: Call DebounceTimer(IN := VISCOSITY_OK AND PASTE_E_STOP_NC, PT := DebounceTime) exactly once every scan outside any CASE or IF block.
When IN is FALSE, the TON resets ET and Q, clearing incomplete debounce timing.
Do not synthesize debounce elapsed time from CycleTime; use the FB timing behavior.

scan_execution_order.name: unified_output_assignments
actions: Compute final VFD_RUN := permit AND DebounceTimer.Q AND NOT immediateSafetyReset.
If final VFD_RUN = TRUE, update PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC := PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC + TIME_TO_LTIME(CycleTime); otherwise preserve PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC.
Assign VFD_RUN, PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC, and PUMP_MAINT_DUE only in this unified output stage.
